parameters.query:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE full_name IS NULL OR btrim(full_name) = '') AS missing_names,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE email IS NULL OR btrim(email) = '') AS missing_emails,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_name IS NULL OR btrim(event_name) = '') AS missing_events,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ticket_type IS NULL OR btrim(ticket_type) = '') AS missing_ticket_types,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE registered_at IS NULL) AS missing_registration_dates,
  COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT registration_code) AS duplicate_registration_codes
FROM event_registrations;

INSERT INTO data_quality_results (checked_at, status, total_rows, missing_names, missing_emails, missing_events, missing_ticket_types, missing_registration_dates, duplicate_registration_codes, message)
SELECT checked_at, status, total_rows, missing_names, missing_emails, missing_events, missing_ticket_types, missing_registration_dates, duplicate_registration_codes, message
FROM jsonb_to_record($1::jsonb) AS r(checked_at timestamptz, status text, total_rows bigint, missing_names bigint, missing_emails bigint, missing_events bigint, missing_ticket_types bigint, missing_registration_dates bigint, duplicate_registration_codes bigint, message text)
RETURNING *;
